title: API refusals: generic 403s that do not name the refused field, refusal messages of 600+ characters, one catch-all datasource code, and batches that fail every row with HTTP 200
body:
qa#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AecbS6JEeLdRWSW4AC

Filing gate: ③ a task on the maintainer's word. Asked in session on 2026-11-10, after the full-platform test run listed its improvement suggestions, verbatim: 「立卡处理」.

QA-source: #32135 · api-backend.error-envelope-ledger · observed beside the clauses
Batch-of: objectstack-ai/objectstack#32135 follow-ups, 15 cards filed on the maintainer's 「立卡处理」

## What we saw

Framework ff04ad81, showcase:
- A member reassigning `owner_id`, or a create with forged anchors, gets "You do not have permission to perform this action"; the field-level refusal elsewhere names the field (`not permitted to edit [role]`).
- Several refusals (`array_agg`, filter comparands, retired keys, datasource credentials) run 300–600+ characters of rationale and ADR history in `message`, which a UI toast cannot show.
- Every datasource refusal is `DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR`; a client cannot branch on the reason.
- The per-object batch door answers HTTP 200 with `success:false` when every row failed.
- `POST /keys` silently ignores unknown body keys (a `userId` for another user is dropped without a refusal), unlike the data door.

## Proposed change

Name the refused field or verb in 403s; split refusals into a short `message` and a `hint`/`details` carrying the rationale (the `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` response already does this); give datasource refusals their own codes; answer an all-failed batch with a non-2xx or 207; refuse unknown keys on `/keys`. Envelope-shape convergence itself stays with #9559.

## Business reason

Who: SDK users, console toasts and AI clients that branch on codes. Cost: users see walls of text or vague denials, and clients cannot tell refusals apart.

## Reader

Triage first touch; lands in `packages/rest`, `service-datasource`, `plugin-auth` (keys).

## Duplicate check

#9559 (open) tracks the envelope-position convergence and gets the new readings as a comment; `is:issue repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack error envelope shape unify` (60, open and closed) found nothing on these items.
